fusions.name: Bolting Barb
fusions.desc: You rush to the target first, then it takes a thrown sting that deals 12 damage, up to 1.6 times its damage at maximum range. Its damage rises 10% per tile you ran, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Hind Kick Spray
fusions.desc: A short cone that deals 3 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 30% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Flushing Dash
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Zigzag Focus
fusions.desc: When you have moved a long way, your critical hit chance rises 15% for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
